name: GBIF species occurrence point-insight overlay with provenance/citation semantics

scenarios.prompt: Show species occurrences within 5 kilometers of Lugano, Switzerland.
Show species occurrences within 10 kilometers of latitude 48.5, longitude -128.5.

remaining_limitation: The chosen bounded valid-empty location (48.5N 128.5W) returned marine occurrence records, so a strictly empty GBIF no-observations boundary was not separately demonstrated this run; the point-insight render, GBIF attribution, provenance/citation semantics, and accepted acknowledgement are the new evidence recorded here.
